items.text: A MIST RISES AND THICKENS INTO NUMEROUS SHADOWING FIGURES. FROM THESE FIGURES RISES A LOW MOANING.
items.direction: ominous fantasy narration; build supernatural dread

items.text: 'WOE, WOOOE, OH WOE,' THE FIGURES CRY PITEOUSLY.
items.direction: perform the ghostly chorus piteously, then return to measured narration

items.text: THE HAUNTS BURST INTO A CHORUS OF HOWLS, MOANS, COMPLAINTS, WAILS, AND OTHER LAMENTATIONS OVER THEIR FATE AND THE FATE OF THEIR FAMILIES. THEY WERE THE ORIGINAL DEFENDERS OF THE KEEP, BEFORE THE CLERIC'S SPELLS INADVERTENTLY BOUND THEM TO THIS PLACE. ONE SPIRIT'S VOICE RISES ABOVE THE REST, 'AN ACCOUNT OF OUR TRIALS IS WITHIN THE DIARY.' HE POINTS TO A FLOORBOARD.
items.direction: dramatic fantasy narration; render the chorus as mournful turmoil, then give the individual spirit a distinct sorrowful voice while remaining the same narrator

items.text: BENEATH A FLOORBOARD YOU FIND SOME GEMS AND A FEW PAGES OF A DIARY. YOU COPY THESE PAGES INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 3.
items.direction: measured fantasy narration with quiet discovery

items.text: THE INTERIOR IS OVERRUN WITH INSECTS. AT YOUR FOOTSTEP, THEY FALL FROM THE WALLS AND CEILING.
A LOUD COMMOTION RISES FROM THE COURTYARD. BASHING OPEN THE DOOR, A LARGE FORCE OF ORCS AND HOBGOBLINS RUSHES YOU.
items.direction: urgent, forceful fantasy narration; accelerate into the attack

items.text: ON A HOBGOBLIN BODY, YOU FIND A NOTE THAT YOU COPY INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 57.
THE HALL IS EMPTY, SAVE FOR SIGNS OF A RECENT BATTLE.
YOU ENTER THE KEEP'S OLD ARMORY. ALL OF THE WEAPONS AND ARMOR HAVE DECAYED INTO USELESSNESS.
PASSING THROUGH AN ILLUSIONARY WALL, YOU ENTER A PORTION OF THE KEEP THAT REMAINS UNTOUCHED BY TIME OR RAVAGING ARMIES.
items.direction: fantasy narration shifting from mystery into wonder

items.text: THERE IS A GLOW IN THE NORTHWESTERN CORNER OF THE ROOM.
SPECIAL STANDS IN THE NORTHWESTERN CORNER HOLD EQUIPMENT.
items.direction: measured fantasy narration with restrained curiosity

items.text: ON STANDS ARE A SHIELD, A MACE, A SWORD, AND A SMALL SUIT OF CHAINMAIL. THE EQUIPMENT HAS NOT BEEN TARNISHED BY THE PASSING YEARS.
items.direction: measured fantasy narration with growing wonder
